mapper.sql: SELECT d.id, d.dept_name, d.description, d.is_active, d.created_at, d.updated_at, COUNT(doc.id) AS active_doctor_count FROM departments d LEFT JOIN doctors doc ON doc.department_id = d.id AND doc.is_active = 1
mapper.select: GROUP BY d.id ORDER BY d.dept_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO departments (dept_name, description, is_active, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{deptName}, #{description}, 1, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE departments SET dept_name = #{deptName}, description = #{description}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id}
